discoverBook.q: How do I discover clubs and book a table?
discoverBook.a: Open Discover, choose a club, tap Book table, pick date, time, duration, and table type, then submit. The club owner approves or rejects your request.

payBooking.q: When and how do I pay for a booking?
payBooking.a: After the club accepts your booking, tap Payment due on My Bookings or open the booking and tap Pay now. You pay the full estimated amount securely via Razorpay.

cancelBooking.a: Yes, while the request is pending or before the cancellation window (shown on the booking). If you already paid, a full refund is processed when cancellation is allowed.

sessionHistory.q: Where is my play history and bill?
sessionHistory.a: Open History to see completed sessions, duration, snacks, and totals. Tap a session for the full breakdown.

liveStreams.a: When a club is broadcasting, open the Live tab to watch. Streams are for viewing only; booking and payment are separate.

accountFrozen.q: Why is my account frozen or flagged?
accountFrozen.a: Platform support may freeze accounts for policy reasons. A club flag means an owner reported an issue — contact customer care if you believe it is a mistake.

changePhone.q: How do I change my phone number?
changePhone.a: Phone numbers are verified at registration. Email customer care from Profile → Help & customer care so an admin can update your account securely.

notifications.a: Important announcements from A3 Billiards appear under Notifications on Home. These are official messages from our support team.
